verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents Composition Revisions as a first-party way to 'manage changes to Compositions with revisions', which gives versioning of the composition pipelines that act as its automations. The CLI can render and test Composition Functions without a cluster, which supports pre-apply review. Rollback to a prior revision is not explicitly documented, and the Git-based review raised by the community is a user-side GitOps workflow rather than a product feature. missing for 10: explicit documented rollback to a prior revision, a first-party review/approval workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of revision-based rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Composition Revisions - Manage changes to Compositions with revisions
testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without the need to access a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane
